reading.title: Sales tax rebate for Larkspur Commons

candidates.quote: First. The Village Board approves a rebate of the Village share of sales tax on building materials for Larkspur Commons, not to exceed $350,000.
candidates.value: Sales tax rebate not to exceed $350,000

candidates.quote: Second. The rebate is paid only while each condition in Exhibit A is met.
candidates.wording: paid only while each condition in Exhibit A is met
candidates.value: Rebate conditioned on meeting Exhibit A

candidates.quote: Third. The Village Administrator shall report to the Board each year on whether the conditions are met.
Sixteen of the sixty-four homes are rented at restricted rents.
Each of those homes is rented to a household at or below fifty percent of area median income.
candidates.wording: at or below fifty percent of area median income

candidates.quote: The restrictions stay in place until at least January 1, 2066.
The builder gives the Village a yearly list of the restricted homes and the rents charged.
candidates.wording: gives the Village a yearly list
candidates.value: Yearly list of homes and rents
